table.QUESTION_CARD_NONE: The card does not say that. Nothing was changed; the card is below.
table.QUESTION_NO_CARD: I do not see a card waiting for you in this chat right now. If you want, ask me what waits for you.
table.QUESTION_CARD_WORD: To approve, tap Approve or reply “yes”, with no question mark. To reject, tap Reject or reply “no”. Nothing was decided; the card is below.
table.QUESTION_OTHER: I can answer questions about your e-mail, calendar, files and to-do list, about the platform's own work, and about a card that waits for you. For anything else I can search the web: ask with “research” and your question.
table.CAN_YES: Yes, I can do that from here: just ask. Nothing is changed before you approve it.
table.CAN_CARD: Yes: a card is approved or rejected with its own buttons, or by replying “yes” or “no” (with no question mark) while it is the last message.
table.UNDERSTOOD_DONE: look at your cards of the last 7 days and tell you how each one ended
table.DONE_NONE: I found no such card in the last 7 days.
table.DONE_STATE_REPLACED: replaced by a newer card, nothing was done
table.DONE_STATE_CANCELLED: closed without approval, nothing was done
